## Marcus – Patient Note

**Date:** 2023-10-27

**HPI:** Patient presents with severe pain and limited range of motion in the right knee following a diagnosis of total knee arthroplasty candidate due to bone-on-bone medial narrowing and subchondral sclerosis.  Patient reports chronic pain exacerbated by activity.

**Physical Exam:**  Range of motion restricted, palpable tenderness to palpation at the medial joint line. Gait is hesitant.  Neurological examination unremarkable.

**Management Plan:** Initiate conservative treatment including weight management, physical therapy focusing on strengthening and range of motion exercises, and potential intra-articular injections.  Monitor for signs of complications such as osteomyelitis or infection.  Discuss surgical options with patient regarding risks and benefits
